meaning: to go to work; to be at work
usage: Used to describe going to work or being at work
Commonly used in everyday spoken Cantonese

examples.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 faan1 gung1
examples.meaning: I have to go to work today.

examples.jyutping: keoi5 ji5 ging1 faan1 gung1 laa3
examples.meaning: He/She has already gone to work.
